narration_styles.name: Bad Memory Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator tells the story with exaggerated or incorrect details and admits they may be remembering it wrong.

narration_styles.name: Multiple Perspectives Mode
narration_styles.description: Different characters retell the same event with biased or contradictory versions.

narration_styles.name: Censored Future Mode
narration_styles.description: A future narrator softens or censors details to protect the listener.

narration_styles.name: Scrambled Timeline Mode
narration_styles.description: Events appear out of order with abrupt jumps between past, present, and future.

narration_styles.name: Chaos-Point Opening
narration_styles.description: The story begins at the climax and rewinds to explain how everything escalated.

narration_styles.name: Revisionist Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator keeps correcting themselves mid-story as new (or inconvenient) memories surface.

narration_styles.name: Object Witness Mode
narration_styles.description: An object or place narrates the events from its own limited point of view.

narration_styles.name: Puzzle Piece Mode
narration_styles.description: Several disconnected stories reveal a single connected meaning at the end.

narration_styles.name: Frame Narrative Mode
narration_styles.description: The story is told through an interview, letter, confession, video log, or another framing context.

narration_styles.name: Rulebook Mode
narration_styles.description: The story unfolds according to a character's personal rulebook, list, manifesto, or philosophy.

narration_styles.name: Altered State Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator is drunk, sick, anxious, high, euphoric, or otherwise unreliable due to their state.

narration_styles.name: Future Cutaway Mode
narration_styles.description: Brief glimpses into the future interrupt the story to show eventual consequences.

narration_styles.name: Nested Story Mode
narration_styles.description: One story lives inside another, with characters telling stories within stories.

narration_styles.name: Hidden Structure Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrative secretly follows a countdown, pattern, or structural gimmick revealed later.

narration_styles.name: Adaptive Audience Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator adjusts how the story is told based on who they believe is listening.

narration_styles.name: Unspoken Feelings Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator refuses to state their true emotions, leaving the reader to infer everything.

narration_styles.name: Parallel Lives Mode
narration_styles.description: Two versions of events unfold simultaneously in alternate timelines.

narration_styles.name: Circular Narrative Mode
narration_styles.description: The story ends where it begins, revealing a loop or repeated moment.

narration_styles.name: Countdown Mode
narration_styles.description: The story slowly counts down to a known event, disaster, or reveal.

narration_styles.name: Prophecy Misdirection Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator hints at future events but the meaning is misunderstood until the end.

narration_styles.name: Mythologized Memory Mode
narration_styles.description: Everyday events are retold as heroic, legendary, or epic tales.

narration_styles.name: Petty Grievance Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator tells the entire story through the lens of a small annoyance blown out of proportion.

narration_styles.name: Broken Telephone Mode
narration_styles.description: The story changes slightly each time it is retold by another character.

narration_styles.name: Documentary Mode
narration_styles.description: Characters speak directly to an invisible camera, and the story is framed as a documentary.

narration_styles.name: Interview Montage Mode
narration_styles.description: Different voices give short interview-style commentary that forms the narrative.

narration_styles.name: Diary Mode
narration_styles.description: The story unfolds as a series of personal journal entries or logs.

narration_styles.name: Unsent Letters Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator tells the story through letters they never sent or never intended to share.

narration_styles.name: Miscommunication Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator misunderstands key information, and the entire story hinges on this confusion.

narration_styles.name: Metafiction Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator is aware they are telling a story and comments on the act of storytelling.

narration_styles.name: Rumor Mode
narration_styles.description: The story is told as gossip that may or may not be true.

narration_styles.name: Speculation Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator fills gaps by imagining what must have happened, even if they don’t know.

narration_styles.name: Character Spotlight Mode
narration_styles.description: Each scene follows a different character, eventually weaving together as a whole.

narration_styles.name: Flashbulb Memory Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator fixates intensely on one vivid moment that colors the entire story.

narration_styles.name: Soundtrack Mode
narration_styles.description: Each scene is framed around a song, lyric, or musical cue.

narration_styles.name: Running Gag Mode
narration_styles.description: A recurring joke or symbol structures the entire narrative.

narration_styles.name: Imaginary Audience Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator talks as if presenting the story to a crowd that isn’t really there.

narration_styles.name: Urban Legend Mode
narration_styles.description: The story is told with the tone and exaggeration of a rumor passed down for years.

narration_styles.name: Out-of-Body Mode
narration_styles.description: The narrator describes events as if watching themselves from the outside.

narration_styles.name: Moment-to-Moment Mode
narration_styles.description: The narration slows time, dwelling intensely on small seconds or decisions.
